model.name: BUG5: Drawer detail stuck on first item — selecting different items does not switch content.
model.description: BUG (v0.6.10 drawer consolidation): on /trace, selecting a DIFFERENT item does NOT update the drawer detail — it stays stuck on the first/room detail regardless of which item is selected. E.g. select link.url → drawer still shows DeFED.net Room; select Files(1) → still shows room. REQUIREMENT: drawer detail MUST switch to match the currently-selected item. Likely over-idempotent renderDetailForRef (b1dd1275) — the ref comparison thinks it's the same item and skips re-render.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the drawer content switch is not yet reliable"
model.crossRefNote: R20.6c (tap→single-select→detail drawer) is the requirement this bug violates. The selection switches but the drawer content does not follow.

intendedChain.useCase: drawer.switchDetail — selecting a different item updates the drawer content to that item's detail
intendedChain.method: renderDetailForRef — must compare by IOR/uuid and re-render when selection changes (not skip via over-idempotent check)
intendedChain.test: RED: select item A → drawer shows A detail. Select item B → assert drawer shows B detail (NOT A). Currently FAILS (stays on A/room).
